subject: Hosted API integration — architecture review & actionable demo plan
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novapay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@novapay.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Hosted API integration — looking to schedule an architecture review

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking the call last week. NovaPay is moving forward on a pilot to embed hosted inference for payment fraud scoring and a few authorization-time features. The procurement team asked us to run a 60-minute architecture review / technical deep-dive with an emphasis on SDKs, streaming responses, and function/tool-calling patterns (we have a few examples we want to validate).

Can your team do a 60-minute session next week? We're flexible but prefer early in the week (Mon/Tue). Timezone: we are on ET (New York). Suggested windows: Mon May 11 10:00–12:00 ET or Tue May 12 14:00–16:00 ET.

Goals for the session:
- Confirm integration patterns (server-side vs. edge clients)
- Walk SDK examples for streaming token output and partial results
- Discuss function/tool calling for enrichment lookups and safe fallback policies
- Surface networking, egress, and key management requirements for procurement

I've copied Mike (platform engineering) who will own the technical acceptance criteria. If you need us to prepare any pre-reads we can do that — we can also share a short sequence diagram.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Liu
Senior Platforms Engineer | NovaPay
Attachments: novapay_context_overview.pdf (stub)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novapay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — looking to schedule an architecture review

Hi Sara — great to hear from you and excited to run this session. We can absolutely cover SDKs, streaming, and function calling; I suggest a two-part agenda so the first 40 minutes are architectural (patterns, security, KMS / egress) and the final 20 minutes are a hands-on walkthrough of a streaming + function-calling demo we can tailor to NovaPay.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Mon May 11, 07:00–08:00 PT (10:00–11:00 ET)
- Mon May 11, 08:00–09:00 PT (11:00–12:00 ET)
- Tue May 12, 11:00–12:00 PT (14:00–15:00 ET)

I've attached a short draft agenda (nova_integration_agenda.pdf) and a living notes file (hosted-api-integration-notes.md) where we'll capture action items. Tentative attendees from our side: myself (solutions), Dev (runtime/inference), Marissa (product), Jonas (security).

Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=hosted-arch
If one of those times works, we'll send a calendar invite and add a calendar ICS. Also, could you share any network egress constraints (CIDR/IP allowlist), KMS/HSM expectations, and if you want us to bring a small sample prompt set?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: nova_integration_agenda.pdf; hosted-api-integration-notes.md
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@novapay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — looking to schedule an architecture review

Sara / team — quick technical notes so we can scope the demo correctly: 
- We'll prepare two integration patterns: (A) server-side inference behind your API gateway (recommended for control of keys and caching) and (B) a thin edge proxy that streams partial responses for lower latency.
- For streaming we'll show token-by-token partial responses and a sample reconnection strategy if interrupted.
- For function/tool calling, please list a couple of the enrichment services you expect to call (internal DB lookup, external risk scoring). We can demo safe fallbacks and idempotency keys.
- Please share the CIDR blocks for any egress allowlists and your KMS provider (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or HSM) so we can align the session.

I'll bring a short live demo that uses our Python SDK + streaming API. If anyone on NovaPay wants the code in advance we can drop a link to a repo.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novapay.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@novapay.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — looking to schedule an architecture review

Hi Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround and agenda. Tue May 12 14:00–15:00 ET (your Tue May 12, 11:00–12:00 PT) works best for our platform team. Can we shift from a 60-minute to 75-minute slot to allow time for security questions? Our procurement lead wants to go through some SOC2 and KMS details with your security engineer.

Also attaching the NovaPay SOC2 questionnaire (novapay_soc2_questionnaire.pdf) — it's mostly standard. For function calling examples we have two typical enrichment steps: 1) rapid BIN lookup (internal API), 2) external device intelligence (third-party vendor) that requires tokenized calls and retry logic. We'd appreciate seeing how Redwood's function-calling model handles retries and sensitive parameter redaction.

Apologies — we just realized one conflict on Tue at 14:00 ET for Michael. If we need to move, Wed May 13 09:00–10:30 ET is our fallback. Which would be easier on your end?

Thanks,
Sara
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@novapay.com>, Michael Cho <michael.cho@novapay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — looking to schedule an architecture review

Sara — thanks for the confirmation. We can do Tue May 12, 11:00–12:15 PT (14:00–15:15 ET) to make it a 75-minute session and include a short security Q&A at the end. I've created the calendar event and attached the invite (meeting-invite.ics).

Confirmed agenda (attached pdf):
1) 00:00–00:05 — Introductions & success criteria
2) 00:05–00:45 — Integration architectures & recommended patterns (server-side vs edge)
3) 00:45–01:05 — Live streaming demo (Python SDK) + partial result handling
4) 01:05–01:20 — Function/tool calling patterns, retries, redaction, idempotency
5) 01:20–01:15 — Security Q&A (CIDR/KMS/SOC2 follow-ups)

Pre-reads: please upload any network egress/IP allowlist and your KMS provider notes to the Drive link above; we'll add a short pre-demo checklist to the notes doc. If you want the demo repo ahead of time we'll post a link to the living notes file.

See you Tue — calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novapay-arch-review
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=hosted-arch

— Hannah
